name: Botanical Clarifying Shampoo
subtitle: Rosemary & Biotin Scalp Purifier
description: A gentle, nutrient-dense purifying wash that removes product buildup and sebum without stripping the delicate lipid barrier. Formulated with cold-pressed rosemary leaf oil and bioactive biotin.
ingredients: Aqua (Purified Spring Water), Rosmarinus Officinalis (Rosemary) Leaf Extract, Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate, Biotinoyl Tripeptide-1, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice, Hydrolyzed Wheat Protein, Melaleuca Alternifolia (Tea Tree) Leaf Oil, Citric Acid.
howToUse: Massage 1-2 pumps thoroughly into wet scalp for 60 seconds to stimulate follicular microcirculation. Lather through ends and rinse with lukewarm water.

name: Restorative Keratin Moisture Conditioner
subtitle: Silk Amino & Jasmine Deep Detangler
description: An ultra-nourishing bond-sealing conditioner infused with vegan biomimetic keratin and jasmine flower essence to melt knots and restore tensile strength.
ingredients: Purified Water, Cetearyl Alcohol, Hydrolyzed Plant Keratin, Argania Spinosa (Argan) Kernel Oil, Jasminum Officinale Extract, Panthenol (Pro-Vitamin B5), Behentrimonium Methosulfate, Tocopherol (Vitamin E).
howToUse: After shampooing, gently press out excess water. Work from mid-lengths to ends using fingers to glide through tangles. Leave for 3 minutes before cool rinse.

name: Intensive Argan & Shea Conditioning Mask
subtitle: Cold-Pressed Lipid Repair Complex
description: Our cult-favorite weekly treatment. A rich, buttery whipped emulsion of Grade-A Moroccan argan oil and raw unrefined shea butter that penetrates deeply to rebuild porous strands.
ingredients: Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea Butter), Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil, Cetearyl Glucoside, Hydrolyzed Quinoa Protein, Camellia Japonica Seed Oil, Glycerin, Lactic Acid, Rosemary Oleoresin.
howToUse: Apply generously to damp hair once or twice weekly. Distribute with a wide-tooth comb. Cover with a warm towel for 10-15 minutes, then rinse thoroughly.

name: Biotin & Copper Peptide Scalp Serum
subtitle: Follicular Density & Longevity Elixir
description: Trichologist-formulated concentrated scalp drops featuring GHK-Cu copper tripeptides, caffeine, and vegan biotin to reactivate dormant hair follicles and curb shedding.
ingredients: Water/Aqua, Copper Tripeptide-1, Biotinoyl Tripeptide-1, Caffeine, Niacinamide, Sodium Hyaluronate, Centella Asiatica Extract, Green Tea Leaf Extract, Ethylhexylglycerin.
howToUse: Fill dropper and apply 1-2 full pipettes directly onto clean scalp in sections. Gently massage with fingertips until fully absorbed. Do not rinse out.

name: Botanical Bonding Gloss Elixir
subtitle: Pure Argan & Rosehip Mirror Shine Oil
description: A glass-finish, 100% silicone-free finishing elixir. Formulated with cold-pressed rosehip seed, marula, and argan oils to reflect light with dazzling mirror luminosity.
ingredients: Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil, Rosa Canina (Rosehip) Fruit Oil, Sclerocarya Birrea (Marula) Seed Oil, Brassica Oleracea Italica (Broccoli) Seed Oil, Tocopherol, Natural Jasmine Oil.
howToUse: Warm 2 to 3 drops in palms. Lightly sweep over dry styled hair to tame flyaways, polish ends, or use as an overnight lipid seal on thirsty curls.

name: Curl Sculpting Definition Botanical Cream
subtitle: Agave Nectar & Flaxseed Moisture Memory
description: A soft-hold, moisture-locking cream designed to clump and define curls from root to tip without crunch, flaking, or heavy residue.
ingredients: Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice, Agave Tequilana Leaf Extract, Linum Usitatissimum (Flaxseed) Extract, Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Oil, Cetearyl Alcohol, Hydrolyzed Oat Protein, Citrus Aurantium Dulcis Peel Oil.
howToUse: Section soaking wet hair and rake cream through in downward strokes. Scrunch upwards to activate curl pattern. Air dry or diffuse on low heat.

name: Thermal Shield 450°F Protective Mist
subtitle: Rose Gold Botanical Heat Barrier
description: An ultra-fine protective aerosol-free mist that shields delicate keratin chains up to 450°F (230°C) during blow drying, flat ironing, and curling wand rituals.
ingredients: Water, Hydrolyzed Corn Starch, Beta Vulgaris (Beet) Root Extract, Bambusa Vulgaris (Bamboo) Extract, Rosa Damascena Flower Water, Polysorbate 20, Panthenol, Phenoxyethanol.
howToUse: Mist evenly through damp or dry hair from 6-8 inches away before applying heat tools. Comb through for uniform coverage.

name: Violet Radiance Brass-Free Cleanser
subtitle: Amethyst Botanical Neutralizing Wash
description: A sulfate-free color-correcting shampoo powered by natural botanical violet pigments and lavender extract to neutralize brassy yellow and orange undertones in blonde, silver, and highlighted hair.
ingredients: Aqua, Sodium Lauroyl Methyl Isethionate, Lavandula Angustifolia Flower Extract, Ext. Violet 2 (CI 60730), Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Hydrolyzed Rice Protein, Vaccinium Myrtillus (Bilberry) Extract.
howToUse: Lather onto wet hair, concentrating on brassy sections. Leave on for 2-3 minutes for subtle cool toning, or up to 5 minutes for icy ash tones. Rinse cleanly.

name: Himalayan Salt Scalp Purifying Scrub
subtitle: Pink Crystal & Tea Tree Detox Polish
description: A mineral-rich whipped pre-shampoo polish with hand-harvested pink salt crystals that dissolve effortlessly while unclogging hair follicles and balancing scalp oiliness.
ingredients: Sodium Chloride (Himalayan Pink Salt), Glycerin, Coco-Glucoside, Melaleuca Alternifolia (Tea Tree) Oil, Mentha Piperita (Peppermint) Leaf Oil, Salvia Officinalis (Sage) Extract, Jojoba Esters.
howToUse: Part wet hair into sections once a week. Apply a dollop directly to scalp and gently massage in circular motions. Add water to transform crystals into a rich foam.
benefits: Clears dead skin & hard water buildup

name: Silk Protein & Marshmallow Leave-In
subtitle: Botanical Weightless Moisture Veil
description: A lightweight conditioning milk powered by slippery marshmallow root mucilage and plant silk peptides. Detangles tangled wet hair on contact with zero greasiness.
ingredients: Aqua, Althaea Officinalis (Marshmallow) Root Extract, Hydrolyzed Silk (Plant-Based), Prunus Amygdalus Dulcis (Sweet Almond) Oil, Behentrimonium Chloride, Cetyl Alcohol, Fragrance (Natural Jasmine & Vanilla).
howToUse: Mist or pump into palms and distribute through clean, towel-dried hair from mid-lengths to tips before styling or air drying. Do not rinse.

name: Raw Murumuru & Castor Moisture Butter
subtitle: Amazonian Deep Sealing Complex
description: An artisanal rich sealant for dry, porous, and high-density textures. Combines wild-harvested Amazonian Murumuru butter and cold-pressed Jamaican Black Castor oil to lock moisture in for days.
ingredients: Astrocaryum Murumuru Seed Butter, Ricinus Communis (Castor) Seed Oil, Theobroma Cacao (Cocoa) Seed Butter, Butyrospermum Parkii, Persea Gratissima (Avocado) Oil, Tocopheryl Acetate.
howToUse: Warm a nickel-sized amount between fingertips. Smooth over damp twist-outs, braid-outs, or dry ends to lock in hydration and seal cuticles.
benefits: Rich in Lauric & Myristic fatty acids

name: Soothing Neem & Chamomile Scalp Oil
subtitle: Ayurvedic Calming Barrier Elixir
description: An apothecary botanical oil blend engineered for dry, flaky, irritated scalps. Cold-infused with organic neem leaf, German blue chamomile, and calendula blossoms.
ingredients: Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil, Azadirachta Indica (Neem) Seed Oil, Chamomilla Recutita (Matricaria) Flower Extract, Calendula Officinalis Extract, Lavandula Angustifolia Oil, Bisabolol.
howToUse: Apply 10-15 drops directly to dry scalp 30 minutes before shampooing, or leave on overnight as an intensive calming treatment.
benefits: Soothes acute redness & itching in minutes
